items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Coltrane in the context of club bookings and musical influence ('post-Coltrane era', 'Coltrane played with Miles') but never claims a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship with him.

ctx.x: Not an engagement here or there, because it wasn't acceptable all over the country; for if it Coltrane wasn't at the Village Vanguard...
Yeah, there were certain clubs in certain big cities.
